items.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025
items.q: Okay he sat right here in high school band. We were together.

ctx.x: Okay he sat right here in high school band. We were together. You know? And we were pretty good. And then the third guy, he could barely play a G on top of the staff. He was one of the first trumpets too. And then the guy that was the fourth one — it was better that you didn’t hear him. You know? But he understood why every person was in band.

That was his forte, besides playing trumpet. He played trumpet. I didn’t take lessons from him ‘cause — he would have probably given me lessons but I didn’t really have any money. We were poor you know and I had a paper route and I bought records with that money. That’s what I did. Every day when we finished when I had collected the money for the papers I knew how much I had to pay for the papers and I knew how much was left. And I’d go directly to Abraham & Strauss.
